patient_profile.name: Patient D
history: family history of early coronary artery disease (father had MI at 52)
patient_profile.presenting_complaint: sudden onset of crushing substernal chest pain for 2 hours, radiating to the left shoulder and jaw, accompanied by sweating and shortness of breath

hidden_ground_truth.diagnosis: Acute Anterior Wall ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI)
hidden_ground_truth.stage: Hyperacute phase, hemodynamically stable but high risk of arrhythmia/shock
hidden_ground_truth.correct_first_line_treatment: Immediate aspirin (324mg chewed), P2Y12 inhibitor (e.g. clopidogrel or ticagrelor), anticoagulation (heparin), and urgent activation of cardiac catheterization lab for Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI)
red_herrings: mild epigastric burning (patient attributes pain to recent spicy lunch, which is a classic patient distraction)

initial: severe substernal chest pain, described as 'an elephant sitting on my chest', radiating to left shoulder and arm

on_direct_questioning.pain_reproducibility: pain is constant, not reproducible by chest wall palpation, and not relieved by changing positions
on_direct_questioning.epigastric_burning: yes, feels a bit like bad heartburn as well, patient thinks it might be from the tacos he had for lunch
on_direct_questioning.recreational_drugs: denies any cocaine or other stimulant use

lab_results.ecg: ST-segment elevations of 3mm in leads V1-V4, with reciprocal ST-segment depressions in leads II, III, and aVF (diagnostic of acute anterior STEMI)
lab_results.ekg: ST-segment elevations of 3mm in leads V1-V4, with reciprocal ST-segment depressions in leads II, III, and aVF (diagnostic of acute anterior STEMI)
lab_results.chest_xray: normal heart size, clear lung fields, no signs of acute congestion or aortic dissection

progression_rules.if_untreated_or_delayed: progresses rapidly to ventricular fibrillation, cardiogenic shock, or irreversible myocardial necrosis within hours if reperfusion is delayed
progression_rules.if_correct_treatment: rapid resolution of chest pain, stabilization of ECG changes post-PCI, and good long-term ventricular function preservation
progression_rules.if_incorrect_or_unnecessary_treatment: e.g. administering antacids or PPIs for suspected GERD, or delaying PCI to wait for serial troponin results, worsens cardiac damage and risks fatal arrhythmia
progression_rules.if_unnecessary_invasive_test_ordered: simulate normal/expected result, note added delay in scoring
